aPlayerWouldStallForBuffering: A player would stall for buffering
above1TheSegmentDownloadsSlower: Above 1 the segment downloads slower than it plays
audioChannelSilent: One channel of the sound is silent
averageOverTheSelectedVariantsAnd: Average over the selected variants and agents
betweenTheEndOfASegment: Between the end of a segment and the start of the next
bufferOfAPlayerRunningThree: Buffer of a player running three segments behind the live edge
connectionSetupHint: Every five minutes the stream's address is requested on a connection made on purpose: how long the name lookup, the connection and TLS took, on average per connection on the way. The rest of the time connections are kept, and there is nothing to measure.
declaredMismatch: Stream is not what is declared
differenceBetweenTheDateTimeTags: Difference between the date-time tags and the segment durations
differenceBetweenTheStartTimesOf: Difference between the start times of the tracks in a segment
durationDoesNotMatchThePlaylist: Duration does not match the playlist
fromTheEXTXPROGRAMDATE: From the EXT-X-PROGRAM-DATE-TIME of the last segment
howLongThePlaylistHasNot: How long the playlist has not been updated
howManyRedirectsWereFollowedBefore: How many redirects were followed before the response
howManyTimesTheResponseCame: How many times the response came from a different host or address than last time
mediaUndecodable: Neither the picture nor the sound can be decoded
noDateTimeTags: The playlist has no EXT-X-PROGRAM-DATE-TIME tags
noDateTimeTagsNoLatency: The playlist has no EXT-X-PROGRAM-DATE-TIME tags, so there is nothing to calculate latency from
outOfOrder: Out of order from the server
packetsWithTransportErrorIndicatorSet: Packets with transport error indicator set
pictureBrightnessHint: Mean brightness of the frame the monitor decodes every few minutes: from 0 (black) to 255. Below 20 with a frame all but dark it is a black screen.
pictureLoop: A clip going round instead of the programme
pictureNotChecked: The picture is not checked: the check is off, or there is nothing to look at for this stream
pictureSlate: A slate instead of the programme
playlistServedByADifferentServer: Playlist served by a different server
playlistsAndTheStartOfEach: Playlists and the start of each segment
playlistsWholeSegmentsAndMediaParsing: Playlists, whole segments and media parsing
programClockHint: The longest time between PCR marks and the least lead with which a frame comes before its decoding time by that clock. Set-top boxes play by it; a browser player does not look at it.
ratioToBANDWIDTHFromTheMultivariant: Ratio to BANDWIDTH from the multivariant playlist
roundTripTimeHint: By the kernel's count on the connection the answer came over: the network between the vantage point and the server, without the server's own time.
segmentDoesNotStartWithA: Segment does not start with a keyframe
segmentDownloadsSlowerThanRealTime: Segment downloads slower than real time
segmentsServedByADifferentServer: Segments served by a different server
segmentsThatCouldNotBeFetched: Segments that could not be fetched
signsOfLossHint: Out of order: TCP segments from the server that arrived out of order — the sign of loss on the way here that a receiver has. Sent again: segments of the monitor's own requests that had to be repeated. Connections are shared by all streams of a server, so these figures say more about the server than about one stream.
soundLevelHint: The level of the couple of seconds of sound the monitor decodes every few minutes, in decibels below full scale: 0 is as loud as it gets, below −70 is silence.
subtitleCuesHint: How many cues the new segments of subtitles have. Zero is a time when nothing is said, or subtitles that stopped coming.
totalDurationOfTheSegmentsIn: Total duration of the segments in the playlist
variantOffsetHint: How far the end of the playlist of an audio rendition or another video variant is from the end of the first video variant, by the timestamps in the segments. Negative means behind.
worstPlaylistStatusPerStepOK: Worst playlist status per step: OK, warning or failure
